character: A halfling cloth merchant in his forties, short and neat and carefully groomed, with tidy brown curls and an anxious open face. He stands with the braced posture of a man expecting bad news, shoulders slightly raised. Careful clever eyes with dark circles under them
wardrobe: a very good merchant's coat of fine russet cloth, bought on the strength of one enormous sale and kept immaculate, now slightly finer than he can currently afford; a neat waistcoat, a folded square of deep rose-coloured Emarrean silk in his breast pocket

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, hands clasped in front of him, braced and neat.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, anxious and earnest, dark circles under careful eyes.

scene.framing: Standing behind a cloth merchant's counter stacked with bolts of fabric, a single length of deep rose silk framed on the wall behind him, touching the silk square in his pocket, worried.
